en.headline: Nine injured in three-vehicle collision on Tsuen Wan Road in Kwai Chung
en.dek: Police said two private cars and a minibus collided near Kwai Shun Street Playground at about 7.29pm, leaving nine minibus passengers with minor injuries.
body: Police received a report at about 7.29pm on Monday that two private cars and a minibus travelling towards Tsuen Wan collided on Tsuen Wan Road near Kwai Shun Street Playground in Kwai Chung.
Nine people on the minibus — four men and five women aged between 30 and 50 — sustained minor injuries, police said. The Fire Services Department sent multiple ambulances to the scene.

Because of the hazardous location, responders moved the three vehicles to Texaco Road near Tsuen Wan Industrial Centre to continue treating the injured. The Transport Department said the fast lane towards Tuen Mun Road near Hing Fong Road was closed, causing congestion in the area.

zh.headline: 荃灣路葵涌三車相撞九人受傷
zh.dek: 警方表示，周一晚上約7時29分，兩輛私家車與一輛小巴在葵涌葵順街遊樂場附近相撞，小巴上九名乘客輕傷。
body: 警方接報，周一晚上約7時29分，兩輛私家車及一輛小巴沿荃灣方向行駛時，在葵涌荃灣路近葵順街遊樂場相撞。
小巴上九人受傷，包括四名男及五名女，年齡介乎30至50歲，傷勢均屬輕微。消防處派出多輛救護車到場。
因事發位置危險，救援人員將三輛涉事車輛移至德士古道近荃灣工業中心繼續治理傷者。運輸署表示，往屯門公路方向近興芳路的快線一度封閉，該區交通擠塞。
